build_escnmd_backbone: build an eSCNMDBackbone model with configurable sphere channels, lmax, and num_layers for equivariant message passing
build_mlp_efs_head: build an MLP_EFS_Head to predict energy, forces, and stress via autograd derivatives from node embeddings
build_mlp_stress_head: build an MLP_Stress_Head that predicts isotropic and anisotropic stress tensor components separately then recomposes
build_linear_force_head: build a Linear_Force_Head using SO3_Linear with lmax=1 to predict equivariant force vectors from node embeddings
build_linear_energy_head: build a Linear_Energy_Head that reduces node embeddings to a single energy scalar via a linear layer
